summary: Corrected WP-P3 Operator Journey and Production Release implementation handoff, scoped only to semprod-wp-operator-release and consuming protected-topology correction b41bdbd3. Compose accepted WP-P1 persistence/backfill and WP-P2 retrieval/readiness public boundaries into argo init -> canonical structural projection -> SemanticIndexPending -> explicit or approved opted-in semantic backfill -> explicit readiness verification -> semantic query. The two successful fixtures are deep-equal except for automatic-backfill opt-in; interruption/resume is separate. Approved configuration validation precedes explicit or automatic backfill, provider, and database activity. Rejected opt-ins preserve the exact post-rejection full-snapshot envelope, produce zero semantic/canonical effects, and expose complete production-redacted error payloads with no forbidden canaries. Exact default production factory/tool wiring and authorized-source safety are frozen by two additional guards. explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run two otherwise-identical successful fresh-project journeys through the production semantic operator command adapter, varying only automaticBackfillOptIn; run interruption/resume as a separate recovery fixture. Run opted-in missing, unsafe, and unapproved configuration controls while preserving each complete observable production error payload.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Both successful event ledgers place approved configuration validation before explicit/automatic backfill start, provider, and database activity. No opt-in reports actionable SemanticIndexPending and zero auto-start. Recovery surfaces progress/checkpoint/failure/resume separately. Every rejected opt-in has zero automatic-start, backfill, provider, database, or canonical-mutation effects; its exact post-rejection {status,graphPath,document} envelope equals its pre-rejection snapshot; and its complete observable error contains no secret or unsafe-source canary.
